title: Queen mate
tip: Box the king in with the queen a knight's move away, then bring your king. Watch for stalemate.

title: Rook mate
tip: Use the rook to cut the board, bring your king to face theirs (opposition), then check along the edge.

title: Two-rook ladder
tip: Rooks take turns checking and guarding the next rank. Keep them far from the king.

title: Two bishops mate
tip: Bishops side by side build a wall. Push the king to a corner; your king helps from close by.

title: King in front
tip: King on the 6th in front of the pawn wins every time. Use opposition, then walk the pawn in.

title: Take the opposition
tip: Kings face to face with one square between: whoever does NOT have to move wins the standoff. Lead with your king, not the pawn.

title: Outside passed pawn
tip: Push the far pawn to drag their king away, then raid the other side with yours.

title: Lucena: build a bridge
tip: Get the rook to the 4th rank, walk the king out, and block checks with the rook (the bridge).

title: Philidor: hold the draw
tip: Keep your rook on your 6th rank until the pawn advances, then check from behind.

title: Rook behind the passer
tip: Rooks belong behind passed pawns. Push, and bring your king across to support.

title: Up a knight
tip: Trade pieces, not pawns. Every trade makes the extra knight count for more.

title: Up the exchange
tip: Open files for your rooks and keep their knight from finding an outpost.
